Ava (People Ops): Thanks everyone who joined today's all-hands — opening a live Q&A thread for any follow-ups on remote/hybrid/office ops (travel, offsites, desk hoteling, hub passes). Drop quick questions and we'll answer here. I'll collate into the Workstyle FAQ after. Link to policy: https://intranet.redwood/workstyle :mag_right:

Devon Patel: Quick Q — flying from EU to SF for the offsite next month. Should I prebook through the Travel Portal or can I book and get reimbursed? Also wondering about visa letters.

Ava (People Ops): Prefer Travel Portal (Concur) when you can — corporate rates and it auto-attaches itineraries for visas. If you already booked, keep digital receipts and we'll reimburse. For visa invitation letters DM me the dates & full name exactly as passport. :+1:

Priya Rao: Are coworking / satellite hub day passes covered if I travel to LA twice a month?

Marta Lopez: Yes — we have a monthly hub pass allowance that covers up to 8 coworking days per month. Expense tag = "hubpass". If using a non-approved partner, please pre-clear with people-ops (short email will do).

Kenji Sato: Any change to desk-sharing? I'd like to reserve the same desk 2 days/week.

Ava (People Ops): We rolled out "flex+hold": you can create a recurring hold for up to 2 days/week for a quarter. Use Office Booking -> Recurring hold. Limits: 2 holds per user at a time. If you need an exception for ergonomic or accommodation reasons, file a request to people-ops and we'll handle it.

Priya Rao: Lodging question — is Airbnb okay for company offsites? Any per-diem caps?

Ava (People Ops): Airbnb is allowed but must be within the per-diem cap for the location (we use GSA caps as a baseline). If booking shared housing for team offsite, note "offsite-hosting" on the expense. If staying with friends/family, we reimburse the per-diem allowance only, not personal costs.

OpsBot: Notice: Offsite reimbursement caps updated 2025-03-01. See policy doc for new city tiers.

Devon Patel: If my visa processing gets delayed and I can't travel on the offsite dates, do we cover remote participation costs or flexible travel windows?

Ava (People Ops): If a visa delay prevents travel, we can: 1) Offer a remote participation stipend and cover pre-approved remote logistics; or 2) Extend travel window up to +30 days for the same offsite if scheduling allows. Please escalate to me ASAP so we can issue an official letter.

Marta Lopez: Parking/shuttle note for SF hub — on-site parking is limited. We recommend public transit or the company shuttle when available. If you must park on-site, reserve via the commute app and tag expense as "parking-hub".

Kenji Sato: Any special rules for bringing family partners on offsite trips?

Priya Rao: Personal travel or partner travel is not reimbursed unless the company explicitly asks you to bring a plus-one for business reasons (rare).

Ava (People Ops): Example expense submission if you need it (copy/paste into expense form):

```
Expense title: SF-Offsite-Flight
Amount: 560.45
Category: Travel - Flight
Receipts: flight.pdf
Tag: offsite-may-2025
```

Ava (People Ops): Thanks for the questions — I'll update the pinned FAQ doc in this channel with these clarifications and the policy links. If you need one-off approvals or visa letters, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com. :spiral_note_pad:
